reconnect.title: Connection lost — getting you back in…

graphicsSettings.heading: Graphics
graphicsSettings.hint: Turn off for better performance on low-end or mobile devices.

villager.name: Villager
villager.hint: Someone here is not who they seem. Find them.

stranger.name: Stranger
stranger.hint: Blend in. Do not get caught.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.hint: You can shield one soul from the knife. Choose well.

detective.name: Detective
detective.hint: Examine a body — someone who was recently nearby may turn up. Not always the killer.

lamplighter.name: Lamplighter
lamplighter.hint: Light the lamp to lay the whole town bare for a few seconds. Use it wisely — you only get two.

watchman.name: Watchman
watchman.hint: Bug a room. Whoever passes through it is yours to see, at the next meeting.

medium.name: Medium
medium.hint: The dead have things to say. You're the only one who can hear them.

alderman.name: Alderman
alderman.hint: Once, when it matters most, your vote will count for two.

constable.name: Constable
constable.hint: You may execute someone during a meeting. Guess wrong, and you go down with them.

shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
shapeshifter.hint: Briefly wear another face. Whoever saw you last will remember the wrong one.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.hint: Douse the lights, longer and deeper than most. Lock a door, cut the comms, or flood the Lighthouse and start a clock the town must beat.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.hint: Name someone's true role during a meeting. Guess right and they fall. Guess wrong and you do.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.hint: Gag a tongue before the next meeting even starts.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.hint: You read as innocent to any investigation. Let them look.

investigate.hintWitness: A trace turns up: {{name}} was recently seen nearby. They seem like {{faction}}.
investigate.hintNone: No trace turns up. Whoever was here is long gone.

place_camera.revealBlinded: The feed cut out for a while — a sabotage was active.

commune.hintFact: {{name}} died in the {{room}}, killed by a member of the {{faction}}.
commune.hintNone: The dead have nothing new to say tonight.

execute_shot.heading: Constable's Judgement
execute_shot.confirmPrompt: Execute {{name}}? If they are not a Stranger, you die too.

silence.notifyTarget: You have been silenced for this meeting.

assassinate.heading: Name Their Role
assassinate.confirmPrompt: Accuse {{name}}? Guess wrong and you are ejected instead.

comms.taskListOffline: Signal lost — your task list is dark until comms are restored.

game.bellPrompt: Press B to ring the bell
game.ghostBanner: You are dead — the living cannot see you

meeting.heading: Emergency Meeting
meeting.ejectedWasStranger: {{name}} was ejected. They were a Stranger.
meeting.ejectedWasNotStranger: {{name}} was ejected. They were not a Stranger.

gameOver.reasonStrangersLeft: The last Stranger left the game.
gameOver.reasonParity: The Strangers reached parity with the town.
gameOver.reasonCriticalSabotage: The Lighthouse flooded before it could be repaired.
gameOver.waitingForHost: Waiting for the host to return to the lobby…

vote.ghostCannotVote: The dead can watch, but cannot vote.

wires.instructions: Drag each wire to the socket of the same colour.

calibration.instructions: Stop the indicator inside the highlighted zone.

ordering.instructions: Drag the items into ascending order.

rotation.instructions: Click each dial to align it with its target.
